recipe.title: Beef burgers
recipe.notes: This is Annabel Langbein's "Ultimate Beef Burgers" recipe.

method.s: Divide into four, roll into balls, then press into patties about 10 cm diameter.
Patties can be chilled or frozen until needed.
Preheat a barbecue hotplate or heavy frying pan over high heat.
Add oil and cook patties for 2 minutes until well browned.
Turn, top with a slice of cheese (if using) and cook another 2 minutes until cooked through.
